title: miR-106b-5p as a Central Regulator of Cancer Progression and Chemotherapy-Induced Cardiotoxicity: From Molecular Mechanisms to Clinical Translation.
authors: Asensio Lopez, Maria Del Carmen; Ruiz Ballester, Miriam; Bastida Nicolas, Francisco Jose; Soler Pardo, Fernando; Alonso-Romero, Jose Luis; Caro-Martinez, Cesar; Pascual Figal, Domingo; Lax, Antonio
one_liner_zh: 综述miR-106b-5p在癌症进展和化疗心脏毒性中的双重作用，核心为miRNA调控通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are critical regulators of gene expression in cancer biology and cardiovascular disease. miR-106b-5p, a member of the miR-106b-25 cluster, has been widely studied for its oncogenic activity in various malignancies. However, its role as a direct molecular driver of anthracycline-induced cardiotoxicity has only recently been uncovered. This finding highlights new therapeutic possibilities at the intersection of oncology and cardiovascular medicine. This review outlines the dual role of miR-106b-5p as a key modulator in both tumor progression and chemotherapy-induced cardiac dysfunction. miR-106b-5p is upregulated in numerous cancers-including breast, prostate, lung, gastric, colorectal, hepatocellular, and esophageal-and promotes tumorigenesis via suppression of tumor suppressors such as PTEN, BTG3, p21, and SMAD7, leading to activation of oncogenic pathways like PI3K/AKT and TGF-beta. Importantly, we present the first evidence that miR-106b-5p is significantly upregulated in the myocardium in response to doxorubicin treatment, where it drives left ventricular dysfunction by targeting PR55alpha, a key regulator of PP2A activity. This pathway results in cytoplasmic HDAC4 accumulation, aberrant activation of the YY1 transcription factor, and upregulation of sST2, a biomarker linked to adverse cardiac remodeling and poor prognosis. In response, we developed AM106, a novel locked nucleic acid antagomir that silences miR-106 b-5p. Preclinical studies demonstrate that AM106 restores PR55alpha/PP2A activity, reduces sST2 expression, and prevents structural and functional cardiac damage without compromising anti-tumor efficacy. In parallel, artificial intelligence (AI) tools could be leveraged in the future-based on established AI applications in miRNA cancer research-to accelerate the identification of miR-106b-5p-related biomarkers and guide personalized therapy selection. Our findings position miR-106b-5p as a previously unrecognized molecular bridge between cancer and doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity. The development of the AM106 antagomir represents a promising approach with potential clinical applicability in cardio-oncology, offering dual benefits: tumor control and cardioprotection. Coupling this innovation with AI-driven analysis of patient data may enable precision risk stratification, early intervention, and improved outcomes. miR-106b-5p thus emerges as a central therapeutic target and biomarker candidate for transforming the clinical management of cancer patients at risk for heart failure.
abstract_zh: MicroRNAs（miRNAs）是癌症生物学和心血管疾病中基因表达的关键调控因子。miR-106b-5p作为miR-106b-25簇的一员，已在多种恶性肿瘤中被广泛研究其致癌活性。然而，其作为蒽环类药物诱导心脏毒性的直接分子驱动因子的作用，直到最近才被揭示。这一发现凸显了肿瘤学与心血管医学交叉领域的新治疗可能性。本综述概述了miR-106b-5p在肿瘤进展和化疗诱导心脏功能障碍中作为关键调节因子的双重作用。miR-106b-5p在多种癌症中上调，包括乳腺癌、前列腺癌、肺癌、胃癌、结直肠癌、肝细胞癌和食管癌，并通过抑制肿瘤抑制因子如PTEN、BTG3、p21和SMAD7促进肿瘤发生，导致PI3K/AKT和TGF-β等致癌通路的激活。重要的是，我们首次提供证据表明，miR-106b-5p在阿霉素治疗下心肌中显著上调，通过靶向PR55α（PP2A活性的关键调节因子）驱动左心室功能障碍。该通路导致细胞质HDAC4积累、YY1转录因子的异常激活以及sST2（与不良心脏重塑和预后不良相关的生物标志物）的上调。作为应对，我们开发了AM106，一种新型锁核酸antagomir，可沉默miR-106b-5p。临床前研究表明，AM106恢复PR55α/PP2A活性，降低sST2表达，并预防结构和功能性心脏损伤，而不影响抗肿瘤疗效。同时，基于人工智能（AI）在miRNA癌症研究中的既有应用，未来可利用AI工具加速识别miR-106b-5p相关生物标志物，并指导个性化治疗选择。我们的发现将miR-106b-5p定位为癌症与阿霉素诱导心脏毒性之间先前未被识别的分子桥梁。AM106 antagomir的开发代表了一种在心脏肿瘤学中具有潜在临床应用前景的方法，提供双重益处：肿瘤控制和心脏保护。将这一创新与AI驱动的患者数据分析相结合，可能实现精准风险分层、早期干预和改善预后。因此，miR-106b-5p成为转化癌症患者心力衰竭风险临床管理的关键治疗靶点和候选生物标志物。
